card.name: Section numbers and brackets in labels
card.fires_on: Digits after a decimal point in section cross-references like (2.6), and opening parentheses or brackets before units. Also the middle letter of brand names such as TruGuard or TRUQAP.

modes.label: Section cross-reference digits
modes.description: The digit after the point in a parenthesized label section reference.

modes.label: Parenthesis before units or values
modes.description: An opening parenthesis in dose tables, before a unit or the next value.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: The letter U partway through a capitalized brand name.
modes.example: days, resume TR<<U>>QAP at same dose or one lower
